en: A sepia-toned image showing a bustling European street scene. The street is flanked by ornate historic buildings with domes and spires, and a large church or cathedral tower with a clock dominates the right side. There are people walking on the street and sidewalks, trees in the foreground, and a tram visible. The architecture suggests a Central European city, possibly from the Austro-Hungarian era.
